messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "read label of other medicine to check for potassium content"
set: ["read label of other medicine to check for potassium content", "check medicine label before injecting", "check label of every pain medicine you take", "check product label for complete list of ingredients", "check your label for storage instructions", "check labels for potassium chloride", "check medicine label to see if should take with food or not", "check the instructions on the label", "read instructions for use", "check for problems early", "read instructions for use with prescription", "read and carefully follow any Instructions for Use provided with medicine", "use oral solution only because of its alcohol content", "check for interactions via provided link", "read all medication guides", "follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
